item.title: Trump wanted retribution in Indiana. Primary results show he can still deliver it
item.description: Indiana Republicans choose Trump-backed candidates for state Senate race. Analysis shows Trump's continued influence in Republican primaries.

item.title: Mexico moved extradition goalposts after U.S. indicted top politician over cartel ties: experts
item.description: The Claudia Sheinbaum administration's demand for "irrefutable" proof before handing over a top elected politician to the U.S. over alleged drug cartel dealings reveals how the Mexican government applies a double standard in its stated battle against organized crime.

item.title: 'The rats are like a storm': Palestinians seeking refuge in rubble struggle with rodent infestations
item.description: Palestinians living in tents amid the rubble in the Gaza Strip and aid groups trying to help them say rodent infestations have left them suffering from diseases and unsure how to cope.

item.title: Trump pauses U.S. effort to guide vessels through Strait of Hormuz in bid to make deal with Iran
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump says that he has paused the U.S. effort to guide stranded vessels out of the Strait of Hormuz to finalize an Iran deal.

item.title: The Kremlin has been throttling the internet and blaming security threats. Many Russians aren't buying it
item.description: In Moscow, residents have experienced multiple internet outages recently, which have made it impossible to use the mobile web. The government says the measures are necessary for security.

item.title: Canada and Europe should get 'creative' in forging closer ties, EU ambassador says
item.description: The EU's Ambassador to Canada, Geneviève Tuts, says the bloc is looking to "elevate" its relationship with Canada amid growing concerns about American isolationism.

item.title: Human-to-human transmission of killer hantavirus suspected in cruise ship outbreak
item.description: Health officials are investigating a rare suspected case of human-to-human transmission of hantavirus aboard a cruise ship, with nearly 150 people potentially exposed including 4 Canadians.

item.title: Russian missile, drone strikes leave 22 dead in Ukraine in series of attacks
item.description: Russian missile and drone strikes have killed 22 people across Ukraine in a series of attacks, as tensions continue to escalate despite calls for a truce.

item.title: Explosion at a China fireworks factory kills at least 26, injures dozens more
item.description: A massive explosion at a fireworks factory in China has killed at least 26 people and injured dozens more, highlighting ongoing safety concerns in industrial facilities.

item.title: 2 dead, 3 seriously hurt after car plows into people in German city of Leipzig
item.description: Two people have died and three others were seriously injured after a car plowed into a crowd in the German city of Leipzig, in what authorities are investigating.
